items.title: v2.1.174
items.bullet_md: - 🛠 **[v2.1.174](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.174)** — _Claude Code releases_. — v2.1.174 adds a wheelScrollAccelerationEnabled setting for fullscreen mouse-wheel control and fixes the /model picker to show Opus as its own row on Max and Enterprise plans.

score_components.taste_reason: Minor QoL release (wheel scroll acceleration, /model picker showing Opus on Max/Enterprise); useful for daily CC users but doesn't change workflows.

items.title: Making secret scanning more trustworthy: Reducing false positives at scale
items.bullet_md: - 🛠 **[Making secret scanning more trustworthy: Reducing false positives at scale](https://github.blog/security/making-secret-scanning-more-trustworthy-reducing-false-positives-at-scale/)** — _GitHub AI blog_. — GitHub's secret scanning now routes candidate alerts through an LLM verification step adapted from Agentic Secret Finder, cutting false positives by over 75%.

score_components.taste_reason: Concrete GitHub feature using LLM reasoning to reduce secret-scanning false positives; relevant for any dev managing repos at scale.

items.title: v2.1.173
items.bullet_md: - 🛠 **[v2.1.173](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.173)** — _Claude Code releases_. — v2.1.173 normalizes Fable 5 model names by stripping the [1m] suffix automatically and silences a spurious sandbox warning on Windows.

score_components.taste_reason: Tiny patch (Fable 5 name normalization, Windows sandbox warning silence); useful for affected users but too minor to stop for.

items.title: OpenAI to acquire Ona
items.bullet_md: - 🟢 **[OpenAI to acquire Ona](https://openai.com/index/openai-to-acquire-ona)** — _OpenAI blog_. — OpenAI is acquiring Ona (spun out of Gitpod) to give Codex persistent cloud workspaces — Codex now has 5M weekly users (up 400% since January), and the deal means agents can keep running for hours after you close your laptop.

score_components.taste_reason: Strategic acquisition giving Codex persistent cloud dev environments; major signal for enterprise Codex trajectory and long-running agent workflows.

items.title: BBVA puts AI at the core of banking with OpenAI
items.bullet_md: - 🟢 **[BBVA puts AI at the core of banking with OpenAI](https://openai.com/index/bbva)** — _OpenAI blog_. — BBVA scaled ChatGPT Enterprise to 100,000 employees and is partnering with OpenAI to accelerate AI-powered banking transformation worldwide.

score_components.taste_reason: Enterprise ChatGPT deployment (BBVA/100K); duplicates known pattern from state-of-ai (KPMG/276K), no new insight.

items.title: Building with Anthropic's Fable 5 LIVE - Is It Really Worth the Hype?

score_components.taste_reason: Independent hands-on Fable 5 evaluation with a clear price-to-performance question (2x premium vs Opus 4.8); concrete testing from a known builder.

items.title: The Pulse: Did Anthropic’s new model just boost rival Codex’s market share?
items.bullet_md: - 📝 **[The Pulse: Did Anthropic's new model just boost rival Codex's market share?](https://newsletter.pragmaticengineer.com/p/did-anthropics-new-model-just-boost)** — _Pragmatic Engineer_. — Pragmatic Engineer reports Anthropic's Fable stores prompts for 30+ days and nerfs performance when it detects potential commercial use, pushing frustrated developers toward smart routing and rival Codex.

score_components.taste_reason: Credible analysis from Pragmatic Engineer on Fable restrictions driving Codex adoption; timely switching-costs discussion the audience will engage with.

items.title: Calibration Drift Under Reasoning: How Chain-of-Thought Budgets Induce Overconfidence in Large Language Models
items.bullet_md: - 🧪 **[Calibration Drift Under Reasoning: How Chain-of-Thought Budgets Induce Overconfidence in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.11211)** — _arXiv cs.CL_. — Pushing chain-of-thought reasoning past a task-specific threshold causes LLMs to become systematically overconfident in wrong answers — the paper introduces CABStop, a stopping rule that halts reasoning when confidence diverges from accuracy.

score_components.taste_reason: Concrete experimental finding (CoT budgets → systematic overconfidence past a threshold); practical implications for anyone tuning reasoning model inference.
